card.name: Academic text before psychology terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or name parts in academic or psychology writing, where a word like emotional or cognitive could plausibly come next. Examples are 'for', 'to', 'of' and the start of a citation name.

modes.label: Linking words in research prose
modes.description: Short words such as for, to or of in study-methods or psychology passages.

modes.label: Citation and name parts
modes.description: Pieces of author names or reference numbers in psychology citations.
